name: The Franchise: Super Bowl LVIII
overview: The 2023 Kansas City Chiefs’ season concludes with a clash against the San Francisco 49ers in Super Bowl LVIII. On the heels of one of the most challenging playoff runs in franchise history, Patrick Mahomes and Clark Hunt reflect on how difficult it is to make it back to the Super Bowl. After defeating Baltimore, the Chiefs lock in on Super Bowl preparation and prepare to drown out the distractions that come with Super Bowl Week. Rashee Rice experiences his first Super Bowl Opening Night as Andy Reid’s Chiefs field thousands of questions from the press. After managing the chaos of the week, the Chiefs move on to practice. Long time Equipment Director Allen Wright reflects on his own journey with Kansas City. Then, Travis Kelce and the Chiefs take on the San Francisco 49ers in Super Bowl LVIII. In vintage fashion, Patrick Mahomes leads a 10-point comeback to knock off the 49ers in overtime and the Chiefs bring home their fourth Lombardi Trophy.
